title: Replay admission failure evicts unrelated active replay window
description: Correctness review: ReplayProtector._get_or_create_window_unlocked evicts an existing active window before checking whether the retained-floor table can admit that eviction. If floor capacity is exhausted, the rejected new-peer admission still destroys an unrelated peer's exact bitmap/LRU state. Preflight every capacity constraint before mutation and add regression coverage proving a rejected admission leaves windows, bitmaps, floors, and LRU order unchanged.
